Clements qualified for the 100 yds. final, but in this he could only finish 4th, but Alan Law managed to gain 2nd place in the 220 final, and the big disappointment here, was the disqualification of Frank Kemp in his heat because of two false starts, a lesson to be borne in mind for the future.

Frank Kemp gave us a good start, which Alan Law and Don Clements kept up, so that our last runner had an easy task in coming home first. We made up two heats in the 100 yards Boys (under 16) race and the final was won by Don Clements from Malden. Mike Stearman was present to defend his 880 yards Junior title, but he was beaten by a newcomer to our ranks in Gerry Trower, with Bob Wolton third.
Wright won the half-mile in 2 mins. 5.6 secs., and Geoff Goode the 1 mile in 4 mins. 43 secs. Don Clements was third in the 100, C.
